methods.description: Follow the outside boundary once, include each side exactly once and add its length. Only boundary lengths contribute to perimeter; retain the appropriate length unit.

Read matching side dashes or the equal/opposite side properties of the named shape, obtain every required boundary length and use repeated addition or multiplication for equal lengths. Squares/rhombuses have four equal sides; rectangles have two equal pairs.

Use the stated Stage3 metric relationships to express all given boundary lengths in the same requested unit before adding or using the equal-side shortcut. Keep the output unit with the final perimeter.
